text:
elaine: Heads-up: CI flagged the audit-event validation smoke test after yesterday's RBAC change. Failing on KMS-encrypted actor field, golden fixtures mismatch. Has anyone triaged?

raj: saw that, digging. initial failure looks like actor.id is being redacted to "[REDACTED]" in some events, but our schema expects `actor.id` string. suspect rbac middleware replaced it earlier in pipeline.

security-oncall: @raj can you paste the failing event payload? also which CI job?

raj: job: audit-validator-smoke (circleci) - run 1427. snippet:
```
{"event_type":"user.login","actor":{"id":"[REDACTED]","role":"guest"},"kms_key_id":"projects/prod/keys/abc"}
```

jen: hmm golden fixture for user.login has actor.id = "svc-identity-..." so mismatch. But the validator should accept redacted values if `meta.redacted` boolean is true. Did the pipeline set that flag?

elaine: Good point. The new RBAC change adds a redaction pass that strips actor metadata for low-perm scopes but I thought it would set `meta.redacted:true`. maybe it's not.

aaron: I rebased the rbac branch and noticed the middleware short-circuits before `add_redaction_meta`. Likely my fault. Fix would be moving the redaction call earlier.

raj: For CI hotfix: we can relax the schema check to accept `actor.id` == "[REDACTED]" OR presence of `meta.redacted:true` until we patch. Add a test to golden fixtures asserting redaction meta is present when id is redacted.

security-oncall: Customer visible? Any customers affected?

elaine: No active incidents, just CI. But we should avoid shipping without marker — otherwise downstream audit consumers could break when they expect a real id.

jen: I'll open a PR to update the validator's allowed patterns + add regression test. assigning to @aaron to move middleware and @raj to update golden sets. :thumbsup:

aaron: taking middleware fix now. ETA 2h.

raj: I'll update goldens and CI in parallel. adding a flaky-tag to the job to unblock main for now.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: CI job audit-validator-smoke rerun queued by jen.

elaine: thanks all. once PRs linked here we'll close.

jen: PRs: github.com/redwood-inference/audit-validator/pull/412 and github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2107

elaine: verified in rerun, failing tests gone after goldens update. closing.
